title: Distillation: off-policy (teacher traces) and on-policy (teacher grades the student)
purpose: Distil Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct into the SFT model both ways on the same arithmetic prompts: SFT on the teacher's verified answers, and on-policy reverse-KL distillation where the student writes and the teacher scores every token. Compare both with the student and the teacher.

checks.description: the teacher's answers were kept only when verified correct
checks.because: Rejection sampling: four samples per prompt, the first one the verifier accepts is kept.

checks.description: teacher and student share a tokenizer, which per-token distillation needs
checks.because: distill.py compares the two vocabularies and the encoding of a probe string before it trains, and stops if they differ.

checks.description: on-policy distillation lowered the student's divergence from the teacher
checks.because: DistillationTrainer with beta = 1.0: the student generates, the teacher's next-token distribution scores each chosen token.

checks.description: the teacher is stronger at arithmetic than the student, so there was something to distil
checks.because: Measured, not assumed: same held-out suite.

checks.description: the teacher's habits came with it: both students now write longer maths answers than before
checks.because: The teacher writes long explanations; off-policy SFT imitates them directly, and on-policy distillation pulls the student's token distribution toward the teacher's.
